name: SHAPE Australia Corporation Limited
summary: SHAPE Australia Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the construction, fitout, and refurbishment of commercial properties in Australia. The company also offers new builds, facade remediation, modular construction, design and build, and aftercare and facilities maintenance services. It serves commercial office, accommodation, health, education, hotels, government, defense, transport, aged care, retail, community, mining, agriculture, and entertainment and recreation sectors. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Sydney, Australia.
